body:
## What it does

A quiet daily habit rather than a study course. Each day it sends a single passage of scripture, quoted as it stands, with a few lines of encouragement written around it. The tone stays steady and undramatic, meant for someone leaning on it for perspective and a bit of strength rather than for counsel or crisis help. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Ortix008 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
